claim: With Direct Connect you can use any type of DataSync service endpoint, including public, FIPS or VPC endpoints.
question: Which DataSync service endpoints work over Direct Connect?

values.display: Use any type of DataSync service endpoint
including public, Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS)

evidence.quote: Use any type of DataSync service endpoint, including [public](choose-service-endpoint.md#choose-service-endpoint-public), [Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS)](choose-service-endpoint.md#choose-service-endpoint-fips), or [VPC](choose-service-endpoint.md#datasync-in-vpc) endpoints.
